title: Animals and Remarkable Things
summary: Animals, notable qualities, and describing abilities or unusual facts.
whyItMatters: Animal topics provide concrete language for habitat, adaptation, behavior, comparison, and evidence-based remarkable facts.

mentalModel.title: Habitat, feature, function
mentalModel.content: Connect where an animal lives, which trait it has, and how that trait supports survival.

mentalModel.title: Remarkable claims need scale and evidence
mentalModel.content: Compare ability, distance, speed, duration, or conditions accurately.

ruleBlocks.title: Build an animal profile
ruleBlocks.content: Include species, habitat, diet, behavior, reproduction, and threats.

ruleBlocks.title: Describe ability and adaptation
ruleBlocks.content: Use können, in der Lage sein, ermöglichen, sich anpassen, and dienen.

ruleBlocks.title: Qualify unusual facts
ruleBlocks.content: Name units, conditions, source, and comparison point.

examples.de: Zugvögel sind in der Lage, mehrere tausend Kilometer zurückzulegen.
examples.en: Migratory birds can cover several thousand kilometers.

examples.de: Das dichte Fell schützt das Tier sowohl vor Kälte als auch vor Nässe.
examples.en: The thick fur protects the animal from both cold and wet.

examples.de: Diese Fähigkeit funktioniert nur unter bestimmten Bedingungen.
examples.en: This ability works only under certain conditions.

commonMistakes.wrong: Repeat a dramatic number without context.
Describe a trait without its function.
commonMistakes.correct: Explain how it supports behavior or survival.

comparisons.summary: Two-part connectors combine and contrast animal features.
The communication lesson structures engaging, accurate descriptions.
